notes.notes:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/282972844624393788/0C69C9B52CB503A305D7731D8E73403605322A46/[/img]

Tonight's update is a patch release to fix some bugs after this weekend's big release. We've fixed a number of map bugs in other parts of the game, as well as marking a few last lingering spawn points.

This patch is primarily to address an issue that was baked into the Stratos campaign.  Certain actions you might take on the map in the second level of Stratos (Defense Relay) had the potential to change the difficulty of your game to Easy.  This is now fixed as of v2.1.3.

If you have been affected by this issue, there are two ways to resolve it:
(1) Beat the Stratos and return to the end-game zone and then New Game+ and pick the Difficulty you want.
(2) Email me your saved game and tell me which difficulty you were on, and we will be prompt in resolving all issues.  Andrew@TreseBrothers.com

Our apologies for this and any bug!  We are a small team and do everything we can with quality control, but sometimes things slip through.

[b]v2.1.3 - 4/3/2016[/b]
 - Fixed issues with Stratos: setting Difficulty to Easy bug
 - Fixed issues with drop ship appearing in Leo Drop Zone and Southbound Trail
 - Fixed map issues in Comms Bunker
 - Fixed a few last unmarked spawns across game

This weekends update launches a new chapter for Battleforce with an all new campaign arc -- aboard the fabled Stratos Orbital Station.  Adding to the already lengthy campaign, this new deployment includes 6 new high tension levels and rounds out the game at 55+ scenarios! notes.title: Hot Fix Patch: v1.2.23
notes.notes:
We've just published version 1.2.23 to address a critical bug that was introduced in this afternoons update (v1.2.21).

The issue was on a database level and effects any new game created using v1.2.21.  Unfortunately, the only solution is to delete the game and start over.

We are very sorry about this.  We wanted to extend a big thanks to the first group of players who reported it and were so helpful by chatting, giving quick answers, and sending in their saved games by email.  You helped bring the resolution time down dramatically.

All new games created in v1.2.23 are fine and can go forward and enjoy the wealth of levels in Templar Battleforce.

Please email me at andrew@tresebrothers.com if you have questions, or post here on this thread.  

I have included [url=tresebrothers.com/images/examples/game_1.db]this link[/url] to a saved game I created in v1.2.23 in Normal Difficulty.  It is right at the start of the second level.  If you already beat the first level, and want a quick way to jump back to the second level -- you can download this saved game and overwrite your bugged saved game.  If you have any questions about this process, please reach out to me and I can help!

Thank you for your support and patience,
Andrew, Cory and Martin

notes.title: Update #19
notes.notes:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/365155921119930802/2168F32E1A70AAB94FFB5A60300D13168526B2FD/[/img]

This weekends update brings 3 more helmets to the mix as we continue to increase the options in the Templar designer.  We've also completed a major editing pass on the entire story, cleaning up all the little mistakes and issues.  

We hate nerfing Talents so we do it very rarely.  In this case, we've put a minor nerf on the top levels of Suppressing Fire, reducing the size of its AoE to match Full Auto and also reducing its final -MP reduction from -6 to -5.  The Neptune Talent is still extremely powerful and one you should not miss, but its now better balanced within the curve of the game.

Finally, we've made some great visual improvements to the UI of the RQ tree. We've also adding some missing details like max targets and turn count to buffs, specifically Uncapped Fury and Battlefield Enhancers.

[b][i]Thank you for your support and for leaving reviews, as they help encourage more content, features and updates![/i][/b]

notes.title: Update #15 - Berserk Upgrades + New Faces
notes.notes:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/415811900452247259/AF7BBEDD461E505BDB593787131B8C54FC195D2B/[/img]
This weeks update brings the last planned set of changes to the Berserker's balance.  The biggest change is to the Uncapped Fury Buff, which now imparts a small (+20) but critical healing effect.  As your Berserker's mech charges back into battle, channeling extra Damage and Critical %, he or she also gains a much needed boost of HP.  The Unbalancing Blows cripping attack also reaches AoE at higher levels, helping the Berserk to spread death as well as curses more effectively.  We've also added new axes to balance out the progression of weapons.

Two new faces have joined the list in the Designer - a huge thanks to our alpha team for all of their support!  

We've also included some nice UI updates to the Requisition tree, including colorization based on class, and a selector that shows the most recently viewed level.

[i][b]Please leave a review if you are enjoying the game and to help promote our weekly upgrades, features, and new content![/b][/i]

notes.title: Steam Update #13
notes.notes:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/396674935288208259/F82628401296D2D1D61B9261C133C8CF5DCB4B04/[/img]
We've got another big one for you as we roll into the end of November.

[b]New Levels: Kaldun Factory Hive[/b]
If you haven't been there, you'll someday visit Rychart Prime.  Lovely place, dusty desert world.  When you're there, you'll hear about a tragedy in Kaldun, . . . now you can go investigate!  We've added a short, hard deploy into the Rychart Prime arc, featuring nasty close corridor combat. 

[b]New Weapons: Engineers in the Spotlight[/b]
The progression of Engineering revolvers got extended and slightly re-organized in this release, adding weapons all the way up to Gear Level 9 with the Scoped Revolver and a new Engineer RQ level, the Master Engineer.  

This spotlight is going to make the rounds and there will be some new, higher GL weapons to fill gaps and smooth out progressions in following releases for other classes.

[b]New Changes: Berserk Fury[/b]
We've reduced the Berserk SP cost to 500.  Bring these champions of melee onto the battlefield faster and easier!

[b]New Heat Rules: Benefits of Heavy Armor[/b]
Those armor, gear, and buffs that grant -MP penalties now also increase your heat dissipation.  You now get guaranteed Heat dissipation for the points you've lost to -MP. 


[b][i]Please leave a review to help spread the word about Templar Battleforce and encourage more updates![/i][/b]

notes.title: Steam Update #11
notes.notes:
Update #11 turns the spotlight back on the UI and delivers on a hotly requested feature -- move path highlighting.  Your first click will now highlight the path your Templar will take, and the second will confirm (as usual).  Both convenience of seeing exactly how far you can make it and how you will get there in one.

Hydras are known for lighting up the battlefield, and now they can get the achievements for multi-kill as they deserve.  

We've added a package of balancing changes as well, improving duration of Indomitable Defense, fixing maps that were spawning Berserks as default before Swap, and improving the XP granted if you skip through the tutorial to reflect your game's difficulty.

[i][b]If you love updates, new features and content -- please leave a review to help spread the word about Templar Battleforce![/b][/i]

notes.title: Update #10: New Spawning Rules, New Monster Types
notes.notes:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/401178534930343217/469B783CF142CEC8BAB3DF0F39D29AFD6DB48B2F/[/img]
[h1]4 New Monster Types[/h1]
Our 10th big update brings exciting new variation to the xeno monsters in the game.  As your squad grows in level, nasty monster variations will start to appear -- the Plated Hunter, Predator, Lancer, and Siege Goliath.   Especially if you are replaying the campaign, expect to see a lot of these new monster types popping up.  They are all visually differentiated, so you can see them with a quick look -- and you'll know them from their specialized stats as well.

And more are coming for the Carapace, Hunter, and Brood Mother.

[h1]New Spawning Rules[/h1]
To clamp down on enemy spawning, you can now you use your Hydra's flame to cap a spawn point.  As long as flame is burning on the spawn point itself, no spawns will be rolled.  With even more control over the spawn map, your Hydra brings a new level of tactics to the table.

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/580196620075627293/B244C9EA21466A9C0D4FD3BEE98CA2C175973A3C/[/img]

[h1]Making Miss vs. Soak Clear[/h1]
We've also made a simple change to the damage printing rules which goes a long way.  If the damage is 0, which means that the attack was a hit but it was soaked by armor, the game will now show a "-0" on the map.  This will help you quickly see the difference between straight up misses and soaked hits.

[h1]Neptune's Full-Vent[/h1]
The Neptune got a Talent rework in Full-Vent this time around.  Now you can directly manage your own Heat.  Use Full-Vent to reduce your Heat directly, at cost of move and defenses.  No that your Neptune is going to far anyway, so why not?

[h1]And More ...[/h1]
We've improved some of the Talent and weapon display elements and names as well -- thanks to everyone sending in feedback and fix suggestions.

[b][i]Please leave a review to encourage more updates, content, and features!  No DLCs are coming, just more updates!  If you like that, please leave a review :D[/i][/b]

v1.1.27 - 11/2/2015
- Added Spawn Control Rule: burning fire on a spawning point prevents spawning
- New monster variations added, appearing as squad increases in level
- 2 New xeno Hunter variations: Plated Hunter (+Armor) and Predator (+MP, +Dmg)
- New xeno Spitter variation: Lancer (+Range)
- New xeno Goliath variation: Siege Goliath (+HP)
- Damage show on the map even if -0; differentiates miss / soaked hit
- Improved Neptune's Full-Vent Talent: directly reduces Heat in trade for move / defense penalties
- Fixing incorrect locations in Objectives list
- Burst Fire and other attack Talents include range in detail box
- Improved consistency of weapon naming

notes.title: Update #9 - Captain's Commander RQ Branch
notes.notes:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/396674774189589758/081F598705B3C47AC6A1DFB72C6A2B3FFB8656E1/[/img]

We've got another huge Battleforce update coming hot off the presses.

[h1]Captain's Commander RQ Branch[/h1]
Adding another branch to the Captain's Requisition tree gives your leader even more options on the field of battle.  Now, step into the role of Commander and use Crippling Orders to weaken enemy forces.  Either calling the shots from the back rank with Fire Commander, or using your deep Lineage memories to spot enemy weaknesses with Discerning Eye, you can weaken defenses and open up critical hits at every turn.  

The new Commander branch is perfect for a Captain who works from the back rank, or to soften an enemy up before his or her own charge.

The Commander branch comes with a new relic armor and a new long-range sidearm for the Captain as well.

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/401178534921280488/E018B3A63F7F1AD2C94E1D96F955DC428D798CDD/[/img]

[h1]UI Improvements[/h1]
We're hard at work refining the UI and improving things for speed of play, reduction of clicks.  
[list]
[*] The newest update includes a Next / Previous button in Templar status to page through the list.  
[*] In the equipment screens, if a weapon, armor or gear is unable to be equipped due to Gear Level, the GL is highlighted in red.
[*] Removed the screen transition when Respec'ing for faster play
[*] Lots of other small fixes!  Check the full list below!
[/list]

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/394422442021859798/DA9E68FAEEF5B0ECEBB248B0A21D483199D1C585//[/img]

[h1]Grinding Art and Animations[/h1]
The version 1.1.23 update also includes all new rendered equipment screens for your Templars.  On the battlefield, you'll see improved animations for buffing throughout your Captain and Soldiers.

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/394422442021861745/678ACFDFB0BE2BB60894F6195C7B441BC1090707/[/img]

[b][i]Please leave a review to help encourage more content, features, bug fixes and udpates!!![/i][/b]

v1.1.23 - 
 - Added 5 new Requisition levels: new Commander branch for Captain
 - Captain gains 2 new crippling Talents: Discerning Eye (lineage memory spots weakness) and Fire Commander (focused fire destroys enemy)
 - New Sighted Sidearm for Captain, 4 range
 - New Void Legion RELIC armor for Captain or Paladin
 - Moved Commander's Deployment Ordnance into new Commander Branch
 - Art update: improved rendering of all equipment screens
 - Art update: improved effect animations for buffs, concus grenades
 - Improved equipment choice screens - if unable to equip due to Gear Level, GL shown in red
 - Cyclone-Strike Tact corrected to be an Expert-Proc for Berserk
 - Reduced wait time between buffs, monster attacks, counter-attacks
 - Fixed issue with ESC / middle mouse button when leveling Talents
 - Adjusted starting Hydra Talents to be more easily available (Hellstorm 3, Napalm Charge 3)
 - Adjusted starting Berserk Talents to be more easily available (Strike 3, Unbalancing Blows 3)
 - Improve character status UI, removed Respec screen transition
 - Further improved some maps

notes.title: Update #8 - Hit % and Avg Dmg
notes.notes:
Our 8th major update is working widely across the game to add features requested by the Steam community, tune balancing and fix bugs.

[h1]To Hit % and Avg Damage[/h1]
This release adds the Hit % and Average Damage to the hover you can get over an enemy target.  You must have an attack Talent selected, and the game will give you this critical information.  Make better strategic decisions with every shot, picking your targets based on the information coming out of your Leviathan mech's tactical systems.  Thanks to everyone who requested this, it's a great new add.

[h1]Steam OS & Linux - Change to Static Linking[/h1]
In this release, we've removed the dependency on GLFW2 and switch to a static linking method.  This should make installing and running the game easier for anyone on these platforms.  If you're on Linux or Steam OS, we'd love to hear about how this update runs for you on this dedicated thread:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/370020/discussions/0/490123938429666344/

[h1]Berserker Improvement[/h1]
The Berserk's Indomitable Defense can now be used mid-turn and at the cost of 0 AP.  It will stop you in your tracks as your mech sets its feet for battle, but you'll be able to keep swinging and throw grenades before the end of your turn.  At 0 AP, this critical defensive buff is now even more mighty.

[h1]Class Features[/h1]
We've added details about the individual Templar class features into the status screen.  Their Toughness and Resistance are shown (class-based soak) as well as the number of HP they gain per point of Fortitude, all to help you better plan.

notes.title: Steam Update #7 - New Levels + Fast Enemy Turn Option
notes.notes:
Simply put, this one is huge  :D 

[h1]New Levels + What's Next?[/h1]
There are two new variant levels for the Ferarai Lance, providing new ways to play through this deployment. 

In the what's coming next department, in the aftermath of the great conflict, the Stratos Orbital Station was established as an outpost for monitoring and scientific research of the new Quadrant.  ... but after a year of operation, communications with the distant station have suddenly ceased.  You're Templar squad is going to have to prepare to go in.   The Stratos Orbital Station will be a full length deploy (5) levels, added to the aftermath at the end of the campaign.  No DLCs or price hikes.

[h1]New Option: Fast Enemy Turn[/h1]
Want to play faster?  Try out the new High Speed Enemy Turn option to skip enemy animations and speed up the entire turn.  

If you're playing on higher difficulties, do be careful as this has a tendency to skew toward sloppier play. 

[h1]Templar Armor and Model Updates[/h1]
Thanks to Martin's great work, we've got a fully re-vamped set of Templar models marching to war in this release.  Improvements have been made to every aspect of the Templars on the map, from their weapons to their battle mechs.  We're going to keep improving!  

[h1]Captain Updates and More Coming[/h1]
The first round of Captain updates are focused on the existing Talents and content.  We've fixed Denounce (now adding a new +Crit Vulnerability ability to the game), as well as tweaked the Heat cost for Blade Weave and Honing.

The next updates for the Captain will add new Talents, weapons, and armors.

[h1]More in the Change log[/h1]
There is a lot more in the change log.  We're relentlessly improving the game for you, fixing bugs, tweaking balance, and taking your feedback and making it real.  Thank you for your support and for helping to share our game!

[b][i]Please leave a review to help encourage more updates, features, and levels![/i][/b]

notes.title: Update #6 - Difficulty Patch
notes.notes:
Update #6 works across the board to fix display bugs, improve the UI and improve game balance.

The v1.1.11 patch introduced some issues with a squad's minimum level and that rolled into the level of aliens you were facing on the field and reduced the risk-reward of putting Templars into combat.  This update fixes these bugs and gets things back to the expected level.  Your squad will keep up with your Captain in level, but those who are not being taken into combat can fall behind - as expected - until they are only 60-75% of the Captains' level, depending on difficulty.  The enemy levels you'll be facing on the field are back in line with v1.1.9.  We do not anticipate any other changes like this to game difficulty.

We've also reduced the "wall of text" effect in the status screens by providing short and to the point summaries of which each Attribute and Skill does.  We're also working on templates to show what will be hit by Area of Effect attacks and buffs for a near-term release.

 - Fixed display of gear with -Heat modifiers
 - Enemy move points listed in details
 - Fixed issue with Auto-Block going over 59% on gear and buffs
 - Fixed display of Shield Parry points in status

notes.title: Update #4 - it is a big one!
notes.notes:
Our fourth update is improving the game across the board.

Most notably, it includes "Weapon Pack Delta" which contains a nice set of improvements and fixes to the weapon list, RP costs, RQ tree, adding some missing weapons, and giving a pistoleer Captain some new options.  This is part of an on-going program of expanding and improving the RQ tree - so look forward to more, and thanks for all the feedback.

We've also added a new an exciting rule to help melee Templars.  Your Quickness stat is now added to your Counter-attack %.  Especially for a pistoleer Captain, this will be of interest.

Across the game, we've put the screws to unmarked spawning points.  We've marked over 70 of them, sweeping entire levels and fixing authoring bugs.  I think you'll see the improvements! ... but watch out for those xeno!

We've improved some keyboard support on some platform and added a new hotkey function for the number keys 1-0.  

We also fixed a couple of levels that were either annoying or broken.

Check the change log for all the details!

notes.title: Update #2: Pick your Templars to Deploy
notes.notes:
Our second update is a big one.  We're very excited to deliver a highly requested feature -- the ability to change the Templars you are deploying into a level.  

To be specific, after a level starts and the introductory scene has complete you have the option to "swap a Templar".  This allows you to see the layout of the level and the position of your Templars so you can make the perfect swaps.   I've included the three screenshots showing the process below!
[list]
[*] You may swap the Templar on the map for any living veteran in your roster.
[*] To complete a swap, you must pay the difference in Supply Points (SP) between the two Templars.  A starting Scout costs 350 SP, a starting Soldier costs 400, and a starting Neptune costs 500 SP.  To swap a Soldier for a Neptune, you'll need 100 SP.  If you swapped a Soldier for a Scout, you'd gain 50 SP.  This swap rule means you won't be able to swap every Templar every time, but it established the balance of your core forces and your specialist additions.  
[*] You cannot swap your Captain or an Engineer or any other specialist who 
is required by the level (at times, a Hyrda).  However, all other Templar types may be swapped.
[*] You may only swap a Templar before the Templar moves or takes any action.  For example, you can't cast a Soldier's buff and then swap them out.
[*] Swapping is not permitted in the first 3 levels of the game, and the feature is explained and enabled in the fourth level.
[*] Each level has a hard cap on how many Engineers you can swap in.
[*] Check the library page on Swapping a Templar.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Update #1 and More Coming
notes.notes:
It's our first Steam update to Templar Battleforce!  The first two days have been very exciting and full of great feedback. A huge thanks goes out to our player community for helping to improve the game.

We want to share up front that we are going to be expanding Templar Battleforce.  It is our way, Templar. The game is already very big and rich. But it will grow in content, new levels, and features and keep getting better with your feedback and requests.  You can see that in action here in the first update already.  Also, we want to be clear we aren't going to add any chargeable DLCs for all the new content.  It's not our style.  So get in now while the launch sale is still on!

[i][b]We appreciate your support and hope you will leave a review for Templar Battleforce![/b][/i]

notes.title: Now Live!
notes.notes:
The Templars march to war tonight!  Templar Battleforce mixes precision tactics with strategic army building in turn-based style .  You'll face challenging enemies and immense bosses in over 45 combat scenarios.  But that is why you are a Templar Captain.  Your Lineage runs back 87 generations. The experience of your ancestors flows in your muscles like memory, echos in your thoughts, and guides your swing and step.

Join us on the field of battle, Templar!

As is customary for the Trese Brothers, expect updates quickly.  Please report bugs or suggest features, we will be prompt in improving the game.  

As is also customary for the Trese Brothers, expect new expansions of content coming soon, all included in your original sticker price.
